item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Adds Obsidian vaults with locally selected folders and per-token read/write access. List, search, read, create, replace, append, and trash Markdown notes without a plugin. Revision checks and recoverable prior versions protect editing. Existing tokens and settings retain their permissions; Obsidian starts disabled with no vaults selected. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.
